HELP FROM SABIK
"My eyes and ears at Langley told me you edited your report. Very smart: I'm glad you're looking after yourselves. I like you, and I like what you're doing. If you need a hand sidestepping the bureaucrats, just let me know. No strings attached."
Put this card into the Operations area now and at the start of each game. Check a box to ignore 1 Restriction card for the current player's turn:
When all 3 boxes are checked, destroy this card.

AN OFFER
Sabik has uncovered his face. His appearance is horrific, his skin translucent. You watch as blood pulses through the visible veins throughout his face. He notices your stare and gives a ghastly smile.
"This? Just a memento of my time in Soviet hands."
The smile fades.
"Look...I'm not your enemy. We all want to stop MEDUSA, so let's work together. You can stop chasing me, I can get you clear of the bureaucrats, and we can focus on what matters: saving the world. We won't always follow the rules, but we'll get the job done."
If you decline Sabik's offer, read Debrief 139.
If you accept Sabik's offer, read Debrief 242.
